microkernel_identity.name: Apple cL4 Microkernel
microkernel_identity.privilege_level: Isolated Exclave Secure World (SPTM partitioned EL1/EL0)

registers.tpidrro_el0: Pointer to Thread IPC Buffer (Base of Mrs and Crs)

returns.tpidrro_el0: Output Message Registers populated with response payload

L4_Call.semantics: Atomically transmits message registers and delegated capabilities to target endpoint, suspends calling thread, and waits for server response.

registers.x0: Reply Endpoint Capability (or L4_Nil to discard reply)
registers.x2: Wait Endpoint Capability to block upon
registers.tpidrro_el0: IPC buffer holding outgoing reply payload

L4_ReplyWait.semantics: Server loop primitive: delivers reply to preceding caller and immediately blocks on incoming request endpoint without thread reschedule overhead.

registers.x1: Message Tag with non-blocking flag set

returns.x0: Status code (L4_Success or L4_ErrorCodePreempted if receiver not ready)

L4_Send.semantics: One-way signal or message transmission. Returns immediately if receiver queue is full.

L4_Ep_Call.semantics: Direct endpoint RPC dispatch wrapper used across conclave launcher and client runtimes.

L4_Yield.semantics: Surrenders remaining scheduling slice to microkernel scheduler hook (`_thread_enter_scheduler_hook`).

L4_ThreadSwitch.semantics: Transfers current scheduling quantum directly to specified target execution context.

L4_Sc_Dispatch.semantics: Binds execution context to scheduling context budget and replenishment parameters.

L4_Cap_Delete.semantics: Clears capability from specified CNode slot, decrementing kernel object reference count.

L4_Cap_Revoke.semantics: Traverses capability derivation tree rooted at target capability, invalidating all child, grandchild, and minted badges across all CSpaces.

L4_Cap_Mint.semantics: Derives a new child capability into destination slot with strictly equal or reduced rights, attaching an unforgeable hardware badge.

L4_Cap_Mint_Ep.operation: Mint Endpoint Capability with Client Badge
L4_Cap_Mint_Ep.semantics: Dissected in pmm-server/src/main.c and 01_pmm_server.macho: mints client-isolated communication endpoint where incoming messages carry verified client ID.

L4_Cap_Mint_Ec.semantics: Attenuates thread control permissions, allowing synchronization without full register state mutation authority.

L4_Cap_Mint_Notify.operation: Mint Notification Capability with Signal Mask
L4_Cap_Mint_Notify.semantics: Configures asynchronous event signaling capability bound to specific bitmask channels.

L4_Cap_Mint_Untyped.semantics: Subdivides system untyped physical memory pool for conclave launch and dynamic page allocation.

L4_Cap_Mint_Arm64_Frame.semantics: Derives page frame capability with reduced permissions (e.g. read-only mapping for shared libraries).

L4_Cap_Copy.semantics: Duplicates capability reference with identical rights into target slot. Both slots reference same underlying kernel object.

L4_Cap_Move.semantics: Transfers capability from source to destination slot, clearing source slot atomically.

L4_Untyped_Create.semantics: Retypes raw physical memory into microkernel kernel object (CNode, TCB, Endpoint, Page Table, Frame).

L4_Arm64_PageFrame_Protect.semantics: Updates hardware Stage-1 / Stage-2 translation table entry permissions.

L4_Arm64_PageFrame_Unmap.semantics: Clears hardware page table entry, issues TLB invalidate (`tlbi vale1`), and disassociates frame capability.

registers.x1: XNU Physical Memory Base | BootInfo Flags

xrt__plat_RingGate_Initialize.semantics: Initializes Apple Silicon SPM (Secure Page Manager) hardware domain transition gates between Host XNU and ExclaveOS.

xrt__plat_RingGate_Return.operation: RingGate Context Return to Host XNU

returns.x0: Execution resumes in XNU kernel at exclave trap return address

xrt__plat_RingGate_Return.semantics: Relinquishes CPU core from ExclaveOS execution context back to host Darwin/XNU scheduler.

xrt_plat_Sharing_DataCube_map.semantics: Maps physical memory buffer shared with Host XNU into Exclave virtual address space.

root_cnode_resolution.description: Each conclave process possesses a dedicated Root CNode. Address resolution performs 8-bit index shift per level across up to 2 radix levels.

0x0.name: L4_Nil
0x0.description: Empty slot. Attempts to invoke, copy, or move raise L4_ErrorCodeSlotInvalid.

0x1.name: Allocated
0x1.description: Active valid capability reference pointing to live microkernel object.

0x2.name: L4_Type_Zombie
0x2.description: Capability object undergoing recursive revocation or deferred reclamation.

radix_resolution_algorithm.guard_evaluation: Prefix bits matched against CNode guard word; mismatch aborts with L4_ErrorCodeCapInvalid.

offset_0x00.description: IPC message descriptor encoding word counts, capability transfers, and protocol tag.

offset_0x08.description: First message data register (also used for function selector / return value)

offset_0x28_to_0xff.description: Extended message registers (up to L4_IpcBuffer_Mrs = 32 words)

offset_0x100_to_0x13f.description: Capability registers for IPC delegation (up to L4_IpcBuffer_Crs = 8 capability slots)

mrs_count.description: Number of 64-bit data words in message registers (0 to 32)

crs_count.description: Number of capabilities transferred in capability registers (0 to 8)

flags.description: Transfer options (non-blocking, grant rights, exception format)

protocol_label.description: Tightbeam RPC protocol / interface descriptor ID

error_codes.description: Operation preempted by higher priority scheduling context.
IPC or thread operation canceled by target context.
Message payload truncated; receiver buffer smaller than transmitted data.
Target capability is L4_Nil, expired, or invalid type for operation.
CNode slot index out of bounds or unmapped in CSpace.
Operation selector not implemented for kernel object type.
Syscall arguments out of valid range or misaligned.
Requested state transition illegal in object lifecycle.
Capability rights bitmask insufficient for requested operation.
